review.algorithm_assessment: The character rows represent alternating unit triangles; even columns point down and odd columns point up. A larger downward triangle ending at a unit apex is formed by the two adjacent downward triangles one row above plus the intervening unit cell. Its maximum side length is one plus the smaller of those two side lengths when that middle cell remains. Apply the symmetric recurrence bottom-up for upward triangles, respecting shrinking row bounds. The maximum side length squared is the number of unit triangular cells, hence the requested area. Both orientations and wholly removed inputs are handled.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
